config.goal: Port llama2.cu (Llama 2 inference: a CUDA port of llama2.c, one file) to one SYCL 2020 program, llama2.cpp, with zero dpct helpers and the model computed on the SYCL device. Keep its command line (<checkpoint> [temperature] [steps] [prompt]), its loading of the checkpoint and of tokenizer.bin from the working directory, and its printout: '<s>' on its own line, then each token's text as it is generated, then the '\nachieved tok/s: ...' line. Keep its fp16 storage (CUDA half -> sycl::half) and its fp32 accumulation; CUB block and warp reductions become SYCL group algorithms (sycl::reduce_over_group). A hidden check runs your program with temperature 0 (greedy) on fixed prompts with the stories15M model and compares the generated story byte for byte with llama2.cu's own output on an NVIDIA GPU. Compile with sources [llama2.cpp]. Success requires compile, verify and a zero-helper scan_helpers of the whole work directory (path '.') on the same sources; delete migrate's output (delete_file) once your port is done.
